tex_content.label: asympt
tex_content.html:
At infinity, $e^{\tilde h(r^2,t)}\sim ((1-t)r)^{-1}$, $\tilde h\sim -\log r$, $\partial _w\tilde h\sim -(2r^2)^{-1}$, $r^{-1}\partial _tr\sim C/r$, $\partial _rB\sim C$, and $|G(\tilde\rho ,r^2,t)|\le C_*$ with $C_*$ depending only on $\sup \{ |\tilde\rho |,|\tilde h|\} $. \end{claim}
Proof

↗ prop:standard-flow-asymptotic-cylinder \sketch The cylindrical asymptotics give the first four estimates; the definition of $B$ gives the fifth, and substitution into $G$ gives the last.

□
